triggers.consequence: Principal distribution for Class A notes switches from sequential to pro-rata, and the overall payment priority changes to the Post Trigger Notice Priority of Payments.

triggers.consequence: Interest Available Funds are used to make good the shortfall in the Principal Deficiency Ledger until the debit balance is reduced to zero.

issuer_covenants: retain with effect from the Issue Date and maintain (on an ongoing basis) a material net economic interest of not less than 5 per cent. in the Securitisation in accordance with option 3 (a) of article 6 of the EU Securitisation Regulation (or any other permitted alternative method thereafter) until the Final Maturity Date;
comply with the requirements from time to time applicable to originators set forth in articles 6, 7 and 9 of the EU Securitisation Regulation;

provide on a timely basis adequate disclosure of all information required to be made available to the Noteholders by ING Bank pursuant to article article 5 of the EU Securitisation Regulation, subject always to any requirement of law.

not to change the manner in which the net economic interest set out above is held until the Final Maturity Date, unless a change is required due to exceptional circumstances and such change is not used as a means to reduce the amount of the retained interest in the Securitisation;

to ensure that the material net economic interest requirements are not split amongst different types of retainers, nor are subject to any credit risk mitigation or any short position or any other hedge, as and to the extent required by article 6 of the EU Securitisation Regulation and the applicable Regulatory Technical Standards.
